root_cause.text: The `ext4_mb_scan_groups()` function in the ext4 block allocator fails to validate and clamp the starting block group (`ac->ac_g_ex.fe_group`) when it exceeds the maximum allowed groups (`ngroups`), allowing block allocations beyond the 32-bit limit for indirect-mapped files.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a safety clamp `if (start >= ngroups) start = 0;` in `ext4_mb_scan_groups()` to prevent the first iteration of the linear scan loop from using an unsupported group that exceeds `ngroups`.
